title: Clear the Fork Square
setup: Your knight would love e7, where it hits king and queen at once, but the knight on c8 covers that square.
hint: Find the square from which your knight would hit two pieces, then ask who is guarding it.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rxc8+}} takes the piece covering e7, and {{Rxc8}} recaptures on a square that does not cover it. {{Ne7+}} forks king and queen; after the king steps aside, {{Nxg6}} wins the queen for a rook.
